name: WIN-Partners Co.,Ltd.
summary: WIN-Partners Co., Ltd., formed in 1973 with headquarters in Tokyo, Japan, distributes medical devices through its subsidiaries to healthcare institutions, mainly in Japan. Its products include cardiovascular tools such as stents that release drugs, balloon catheters and ultrasound catheters used inside vessels, devices for cardiac rhythm management, insulin pumps and glucose monitoring devices, and magnetic resonance imaging equipment.
